data.short_description: Bruno's Tavern is set to reopen later this summer under new ownership after closing in April following years of financial difficulties. Former managers Will Wilson, Eric Orlando, David Demarest, Caufman Talley, and Greg Buisson have taken over the historic New Orleans bar. The new owners plan to restore its welcoming atmosphere and sports-focused environment.

Bruno's Tavern closed in April following years of financial difficulties under previous ownership. Former owner David Melius sold the business after the previous ownership group defaulted on the terms of the 2020 sale, leading to legal action. The tavern has now been sold to a new ownership group made up of former managers.

Botánico Cocina & Social Club will open in mid-August at 1106 Crescent Ave. NE in Atlanta's Midtown, in the former space of Lure. The contemporary Latin restaurant and social club is led by Felipe Rivera and Eduardo Rivera and will feature dishes inspired by Peruvian, Mexican, Colombian, and Cuban cuisines. The beverage program will emphasize tequila, mezcal, pisco, and Caribbean and South American rums.

Palo Santo in West Midtown Atlanta was closed in late June after a five-year run. The closure was noted as part of recent changes in the Botánico team's Atlanta portfolio of concepts. The team has indicated the city could see a revived version of Palo Santo in the future.

data.status: expected to welcome its first customers later this month
data.short_description: Smooth Monkey is preparing to open a new Uptown location at 500 W. Trade St. in Charlotte, marking the company's third location in the Charlotte area. The 1,100-square-foot store will feature indoor and outdoor seating and serve smoothies, acai bowls, cold-pressed juices, and wellness shots. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

data.location: 1540 N Main St, Fort Worth, TX 76164
data.short_description: La Playa Maya has announced the permanent closure of its Stockyards location at 1540 N Main Street in Fort Worth, with its final day of service on July 5. The authentic Mexican restaurant has operated for nearly 40 years, serving the Northside community since 1988. Three remaining La Playa Maya locations in Fort Worth and Hudson Oaks will continue to operate.

data.status: grand opening on July 9, 2026, at 6:30 a.m.
data.short_description: Chick-fil-A is opening a new restaurant at 7411 Fair Oaks Blvd in Carmichael, CA, with a grand opening on Thursday, July 9, 2026, at 6:30 a.m. The restaurant will be operated by local Owner-Operator Eric Mason and is expected to create 60 jobs. Service options will include dine-in, drive-thru, carry-out, catering, third-party delivery, and Mobile Thru.

data.status: targeting an opening in the first quarter of 2027
data.short_description: Pirate Panda Brewing, a family-owned brewery, plans to open at 200 S. Oak St. in Old Town Roanoke with construction currently underway. The brewery is targeting an opening in Q1 2027 and will include a children's area, pet-friendly patio, and second-floor private event space. The concept is led by Pablo Medina and his siblings with a focus on community and hospitality.

data.location: 825 S Randall Road, St. Charles, IL
data.short_description: The Wahlburgers location at 825 S Randall Road in St. Charles closed on June 29 due to its lease ending, in a same-day closure. Franchisee Ed French announced the closure on Facebook and indicated plans to reopen at a new nearby location, though a specific address and opening date have not been released. This was the only Wahlburgers in Illinois.

Tennessee's BBQ is closing its Framingham location after 30 years of service, with July 5 as the final day. The Peabody and Braintree locations will remain open. No specific reason for the closure was shared by the restaurant team.

Khao Soi, a specialty Thai concept from the owners of Manaao Thai Comfort Food, will open at Katella Commons within the OCVIBE development in Anaheim. The menu will focus exclusively on Thai curry dishes through a smaller, curated offering. The concept will join a lineup of chef-driven restaurants in the 50,000-square-foot market hall.

Bad Luck Burger Club is opening its first standalone brick-and-mortar restaurant at 501 Gallatin Avenue in East Nashville, in the former Porter Road Butcher space. Renovations are planned for the 1,255-square-foot building, including a covered patio. No opening date has been reported.

data.short_description: Chick-fil-A is expanding across the Dallas-Fort Worth area with nine new restaurant openings this year, two of which have already opened. Locations will open in Royse City, Hillsboro, Azle, Fort Worth, Princeton, Sachse, Melissa, and Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport's Terminal A. The expansion is expected to create up to 900 jobs and includes $25,000 donations to local Feeding America food banks per new restaurant.
